provenance: Hand-authored flat-FOND miniature (ticket fond-htn-06-diff-flatfond, 2026-09-17). Islands-style bridge-building strong-cyclic example (Cimatti, Pistore, Roveri & Traverso, AIJ 2003); 2-island variant where a flooded build must dry out and be retried. No koala files used.
literature_ref: Cimatti, Pistore, Roveri, Traverso, 'Weak, Strong, and Strong Cyclic Planning via Symbolic Model Checking', AIJ 147 (2003)
class_rationale: build-bridge may flood; the flooded builder must dry out and rebuild, a loop, so no strong plan exists; the retry policy is strong-cyclic.
